description: This file provides utility functions related to sharing content within an Android application, including opening a share dialog and extracting shared text from an intent.

classes.name: ShareUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to support sharing functionality in the Android app, such as opening share dialogs and extracting shared text from intents.

methods.name: openShareDialog
methods.description: Opens a share dialog allowing the user to choose an app to send text content with a specified subject.

methods.name: extractSharedText
methods.description: Extracts and processes shared text from an intent, returning a formatted string; converts URLs to markdown links if a subject is provided.
